0022600093.text: The Kings and the LA Clippers both open their 2026-27 seasons, and Sacramento will be without Ben Simmons (Achilles, ruptured), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery). In the 2025-26 season series the Kings lost 1-3, including a 138-109 defeat in Sacramento on April 5, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Sacramento a 35% chance to win.
